error.no_devices: No supported devices found on this account. Make sure at least one MQTT-capable Eufy robot vacuum is registered.
error.rate_limited: Logins for this account are paused to avoid an Eufy account lock-out. Try again in {minutes} min.
error.login_challenge: Eufy asks for a verification code or captcha. Sign in once in the Eufy app, then try again.

data_description.map_max_px: Maximum pixel dimension for the rendered map image. Higher values give more detail but use more memory and bandwidth (1024 px is roughly 2.5x the bytes of 512 px).
data_description.robot_style: How the robot is drawn on the map.
data_description.notify_desktop: Show a persistent notification in the Home Assistant UI (the bell icon) when the robot reports an error.
data_description.notify_mobile_service: Select your phone from the list, or type a service name (e.g. mobile_app_my_phone). Leave blank to skip mobile alerts.
data_description.trail_color: Colour of the cleaning trail drawn on the map image. Applies to the rendered picture the camera entity serves, so it takes effect on the next map update.

data_description.device: Pick a device to set its local-Tuya address and/or room names.

data_description.host: The dock's LAN address, for direct local push instead of 30 s cloud polling. Leave blank to stay on cloud.
data_description.version: Tuya protocol version — 3.3 fits most vacuums; try 3.4/3.5 for newer models if 3.3 fails.
data_description.rooms: Manual 'id: name' lines, one room per line (e.g. '1: Kitchen'). Used when the device's room list isn't delivered automatically.
data_description.map_id: The local map id sent in room/zone clean commands. Set this if room cleans fail — some models (S1 Pro / T2080A) report a cloud map id that the firmware rejects. Leave blank to use the device-reported id. A single number (e.g. '1') applies to every map. With several maps, add one 'reported id: local id' line per map (e.g. '2154: 1'); if a map has no line, the log names its reported id. The first map saved on the robot is 1, but a re-created or additional map gets a new id (2, 3, …), so if 1 fails try the next number.

error.invalid_host: Enter a bare IP address or hostname (no http:// prefix or :port).
error.invalid_map_id: Enter a positive whole number (e.g. 1), or 'reported id: local id' lines of positive whole numbers (e.g. 2154: 1).

abort.no_devices: No devices are loaded to configure.

segments_changed.title: Vacuum segments have changed
segments_changed.description: The segments (rooms) for **{device_name}** have changed since the last known configuration. If you use this vacuum with the Matter Hub, re-sync the area mapping so automations continue to work correctly.

session_replaced.title: Eufy session ended by another login
session_replaced.description: Another app or integration keeps logging in with **{account}** and ending Home Assistant's session, so Home Assistant stopped logging in: two clients on one account log each other out until Eufy locks it. Reauthenticate to take the session back on this account, or remove this entry and add the integration again with another Eufy account the robot is shared to.
